events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) briefly grasps Smart (BOS) in the paint, but releases as Conley's (MEM) drive ensues.
Temple (MEM) makes marginal contact with Irving (BOS) as he passes the ball.
[Detectable with a stop watch] Smart (BOS) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Morris (BOS) briefly grasps Gasol's (MEM) jersey off-ball but does not affect his FOM.
Gasol (MEM) delivers some contact to Smart (BOS) during the pick but does not affect his ability to defend.
RAR shows Morris (BOS) cleanly dislodges the ball as Conley (MEM) attempts to gather.
[Observable in enhanced video] Conley (MEM) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Conley (MEM) makes marginal contact with Smart (BOS) after the ball has been dislodged as he goes to and not through the defender.
Conley (MEM) and Smart (BOS) engage and disengage during the inbound.
Smart (BOS) cleanly steals the pass intended for Gasol (MEM) without affecting Gasol's (MEM) FOM.
Gasol (MEM) makes contact to Irving's (BOS) back that affects his ability to get to the ball.
Brooks (MEM) briefly grasps Smart's (BOS) arm off-ball. The reaction isn't consistent with the amount of contact.
Temple (MEM) briefly brings an arm to Morris' (BOS) opposite side, but releases as moves away from the pick.
Brooks (MEM) makes some contact to Morris' (BOS) arm in the post, but the contact doesn't affect his ability to maintain control of the ball or get into his upward shooting motion.
Horford (BOS) makes contact with Conley's (MEM) body during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Anderson (MEM) makes contact with the ball before he has established himself inbounds.
Conley (MEM) commits a take foul on Irving (BOS).
Tatum (BOS) makes marginal contact with Gasol (MEM) at the start of his drive that he is able to move through without it affecting his SQBR.
Tatum (BOS) extends his forearm into Gasol's (MEM) body and affects his driving shot attempt prior to the ball being dislodged by Hayward (BOS).
Temple (MEM) commits a take foul on Irving (BOS).
